note: ref is the git ref where path exists. pending true means that ref is an open draft branch and default_branch does not contain path yet. After the pull request merges, Lead re-saves from default_branch. Grok Bot copies never write back.

skills.name: ultrathink-protocol
skills.purpose: Plans non-trivial work inside the conversation before a multi-step build, fix, or refactor, including when /ultrathink-protocol is invoked.

skills.name: ultrathink-off
skills.purpose: Remembers that planning stays off for this conversation until /ultrathink-on.

skills.name: ultrathink-on
skills.purpose: Remembers that planning is on again for this conversation.

skills.name: ultrathink-quick
skills.purpose: Answers one message without planning or tracker rows.

skills.name: ultrathink-skip
skills.purpose: Skips planning for the next message in this conversation only.

skills.name: ultrathink-status
skills.purpose: Reports only the planning preferences this conversation remembers.

skills.name: ultrathink-track
skills.purpose: Remembers whether tracker rows are wanted; planning continues either way.

skills.name: swarm-cloud-dispatch
skills.purpose: Lead hands a repository to a Cursor cloud agent that runs the 15 AgentSwarm agents as subagents and returns a draft pull request.

skills.name: desk-shared-memory
skills.purpose: Calls the seat gateway for brief, recall, retain, docs, events, ownership, receipts and doctor. Memory is reached only through that gateway.

skills.name: desk-run
skills.purpose: One /desk-run command that chains planning, gateway memory and Cursor cloud dispatch through to a draft pull request and the Greptile gate.
